verdicts.reason: Both are essentially the same uniformly shrunk copy of the original on a shorter banner. The headline, stained-glass window and details block sit in the same left/centre/right positions, so neither was rearranged for the new shape. In both, the right-hand date and address text is now very small and light, which hurts legibility, and wide empty margins at the left and right make the layout look under-scaled rather than designed. The candidates differ only by a few pixels in vertical position, so neither is clearly better.
